wages.title: Wages
wages.hubSummary: Georgia’s average and median monthly wages
wages.metaDescription: Explore Georgia’s annual average and median monthly wages by employer type, industry, region and sex.
wages.page.overview.title: Wages overview
wages.page.overview.summary: Georgia’s average monthly wage since {averageFrom} and median wage since {medianFrom}, comparing public and non-public employers, and women and men.
wages.page.industries.title: Wages by industry
wages.page.industries.summary: Average monthly wages in {sectionCount} economic activities since {sectionsFrom}, for all employees, women, men or each employer type; the median since {medianFrom}.
wages.page.regions.title: Wages by region
wages.page.regions.summary: Compare average monthly wages across Georgia’s regions. The map and list show the latest published year; select a region to see its wages over time.
wages.regionSummary: Average monthly wage in {region} since {regionsFrom}, with Georgia’s average for comparison.
wages.nominalNote: Gross wages before income tax, in current lari. They are not adjusted for inflation and do not show purchasing power.
wages.emptySelection: Select one or more series to compare.
wages.sourceNoteMedian: Source: Geostat · average from enterprise surveys, median from Revenue Service records · annual
wages.nonBusinessNote: The non-business and financial sector covers state bodies, local government, public-law and non-commercial entities, and all financial institutions.
wages.regionNote: Some enterprises are counted at their head-office location, so a region’s figure can reflect where firms are registered rather than exactly where people work.
wages.regionMapAria: Map of average monthly wages by region, {year}
wages.heatmapNote: Every published activity for the chosen employees and years, whatever is selected above. Darker cells are higher wages; a dash means Geostat publishes no value.
wages.heatmapScale: Equal steps from zero to the highest value shown
